title: G's Dash
description: Driver display and car hub in six looks (M Style, GT, Digital '84, Sim Racing, Lumen, Pixel). Swipe between Showcase (the car, Spotify or a clock), Drive (opens first; shift lights, gear, rpm, speed, g-meter, drive mode badge, oil / coolant in °F), Warm-up (warm-up rev limit), G-force (peak hold) and Tires (TPMS). Optional Spotify panel (art, previous / play-pause / next, seek; own QR sign-in, Spotify Premium and mgu-uplink internet). Optional CarPlay map in the cluster: CarPlay's map on the instrument cluster through the separately installed Waze on cluster tool (off unless installed and turned on). Cluster source (0.8.3, Options > Cluster source, Auto by default): pick what the cluster's centre map area shows - Auto (as before), Logo (also while G's Dash runs in the background), Music (G's Music's lyrics / visualizer, the logo when nothing plays), Map (Waze on cluster's CarPlay map) or Stock (the car's own; Waze on cluster off); route guidance always shows directions, G's TV only after its own Cluster button; shared with G's Music and G's TV. Cluster logo (Auto): while open, the G's Dash logo in the cluster's centre map area unless route guidance runs (over Waze's map too; it steps aside only for the car's navigation, CarPlay or Android Auto route guidance, and for G's TV; with no route signal from the car it stays shown), through the separately installed Cluster renderer tool (on by default; nothing happens without the tool). 0.10.0: a new Options page (Theme, Cluster & HUD, Driving, Spotify, Diagnostics; a Dash button on every page back to the dash); Your look on the car's displays: Cluster dials, HUD or Neither (one setting, 0.9.0's choice kept); favourite looks: star looks on Theme, then tap the gear or the speed on Drive to switch between them (not while the shift lights build or flash); every clock H:MM with a colon, from the head unit's clock (the car keeps it set; Diagnostics lists the catalog's time / date fields for a car clock). Cluster skins (0.8.1: parked and driving): in any drive mode (the cluster's M / Sport layout), the speedometer, tachometer, digital speed and gear redrawn live in the G's Dash look; fuel, oil, ACC / speed limit / assist graphics and telltales stay the car's own; stock again within a second if a signal is late or anything is wrong; and Options > Diagnostics > Refresh cluster to remake G's Dash's cluster layers. HUD (speed, gear, shift lights) (0.9.0, off by default): the whole HUD in the look's style - the speed in mph, big, the gearbox's own gear (none in P, unknown or guessed) and shift lights at the top filling over the last 2000 rpm and flashing at the shift point; hidden on a late signal, no speed signal or any renderer error; no speed limit; one at a time with the cluster skins. 0.9.0: Simple, Heritage and Flight removed (a saved one becomes M Style, now the default); the fuel option removed (Drive shows oil / coolant; the cluster skins leave the car's own fuel gauge showing). 0.8.5: the cluster skins draw again (0.8.4's shader used a name the Cluster renderer reserves, so it was refused and showed 'Refused: no such layer'); skins and HUD lights are used only once the renderer confirms them, a refusal shows its real reason, and a layer the renderer loses is made again once. Tested tools (0.8.4): Waze on cluster 0.6.3 or later (tested 0.7.1; shows its patch service starting / unavailable and why a build cannot be patched), Cluster renderer 0.2.2, GPU renderer 0.5.0 or later (current 0.6.8).

de.bmw.infotainment.drivingexcitement.FE._optional: the drive mode badge: statusFESVehicleDynamicSwitchHMI.actualValueModeDrivingExperience (enum ActualValueModeDrivingExperience2, by name or number); its pop-up request flags mark a change

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.TPMS._optional: the Tires screen: pressures, temperatures, targets, status (UInt16 raw: pressure x0.1 in the car's unit, temperature raw-40; read every 10 s; raw values logged and on the diagnostics page)

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.Vehicle._optional: the car's display units (air pressure, temperature) for the TPMS values

de.bmw.infotainment.navigation.navigatio._optional: the cluster logo's route guidance check: guidingState (INACTIVE / CALCULATING_ROUTE / ACTIVE; ACTIVE hides the logo); without it the logo goes by the phone's signals, and with none it stays shown

de.bmw.infotainment.a4a.carplay.CarPlayM._optional: the cluster logo's CarPlay route guidance check (Waze or Maps with a route): projectedGuidanceActive; without it the logo shows over Waze's map during a CarPlay route too

de.bmw.infotainment.sdi.aap.androidautop._optional: the cluster logo's Android Auto route guidance check: projectedGuidanceActive

startWidget.comment: Home-screen widget: just the G logo, large and centred (widget_logo.js from tools/make_g_icon.py: the mark alone, transparent, at 'size' and inside 'safe'). Same layout and cells as upstream's apps/edrive widget (BMW's Drive Recorder widget on this firmware): the picture goes into BackgroundImage1; every text line and the progress bar are written empty here once per placed widget. The small widget shows no pictures on this firmware (upstream's finding), so main.js sets its Title to the app's name; the big one's Title stays empty. 'safe' = share of width / height kept clear on each side (the HMI crops the edges).
startWidget.name: G's Dash
